title: CampusGo / User service
description: HTTP and logical database performance, messaging and durable event delivery. Current values require fresh application telemetry.

panels.title: Telemetry freshness
panels.description: Instant value at the selected range end. Fresh telemetry is not a readiness probe. HTTP filters apply to completed HTTP metrics; no traffic has no error fraction/latency estimate.

targets.expr: ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name=~"user-service"})) < bool 45) or on(service_name) ((label_replace(vector(0), "service_name", "user-service", "", "")) - 1)

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Instant value at the selected range end. Fresh telemetry is not a readiness probe. HTTP filters apply to completed HTTP metrics; no traffic has no error fraction/latency estimate.

targets.expr: (sum by (service_name) (rate(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service"}) < 45))

panels.title: HTTP 5xx · selected range
panels.description: Histogram/request summary over the entire selected dashboard range, rather than only the current rate window. Short idle periods do not discard earlier requests in that range. No requests means no estimate, and fresh application telemetry is still required.

targets.expr: (((sum by (service_name) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}",http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]))) or on(service_name) (0 * (sum by (service_name) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__range]))))) / on(service_name) ((sum by (service_name) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__range]))) > 0)) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service"}) < 45))

panels.title: HTTP p95 · selected range
panels.description: Histogram/request summary over the entire selected dashboard range, rather than only the current rate window. Short idle periods do not discard earlier requests in that range. No requests means no estimate, and fresh application telemetry is still required.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service_name,le) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__range])))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service"}) < 45))

panels.title: Estimated HTTP requests · selected range
panels.description: Extrapolated request count, not an audit total; fractional estimates and counter resets are expected.

targets.expr: (sum by (service_name) (increase(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service",http_route=~"${route:regex}",http_route!~"${health:raw}"}[$__range]))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service"}) < 45))

panels.description: Current durable account rows. Suspension state does not measure recent activity or distinct active users.

panels.description: Final HTTP response classes: success=2xx, rejected=4xx, error=5xx. They do not identify the rejection's root cause.
